_purpose: Room 4D — Project 001, D-001B Phase 1 controlled import pilot. Extracted questions from source S005. questions.questionText: Which of the following applies to the social insurance program known as social security?

choices.text: Contributions are compulsory for most workers
Benefits are based upon a contract with the insured
Benefits are paid to each individual matching their contributions
All insured workers begin to receive benefits at age 65

questions.sourceNotes: No question number is printed in the source document; sequence is assigned by extraction order within the source PDF for traceability only.

humanAnnotations.content: Choice A is checked as the selected answer.

bilingualNotes.primary: Contributions are compulsory for most workers
bilingualNotes.translation: 对大部分人，社安税是必须要交的

questions.questionText: From the choices below select the one which is false about Social Security (OASDHI):

choices.text: Benefits are installed by federal law, not by a contract.
The benefits received are closely related to the contributions made, actuarially speaking.
It will likely need to be supplemented by the individual participant since it was designed only to provide a minimum floor of income.
It is, for the most part, a compulsory system.

questions.sourceNotes: DUPLICATE GROUP DG-001 (conceptualDuplicate) with Q-S005-018: same question stem ("false about OASDHI") with an overlapping but distinct set of answer choices, and a different marked "false" statement. See data/knowledge/project-001/import/duplicate-groups.json.

humanAnnotations.content: Choice B is checked as the selected (false) answer.

bilingualNotes.primary: The benefits received are closely related to the contributions made, actuarially speaking.
bilingualNotes.translation: 社安福利和付的社安税没有必然联系
bilingualNotes.note: 这句被判定为false: 福利与所交的税并无必然的精算关系

questions.questionText: Lawrence is a 'fully insured' worker. If he were to die leaving his 40 year old spouse and 12 year old son, would his surviving spouse be entitled to receive monthly benefits for the remainder of her life?

bilingualNotes.primary: 40-year-old widow with a 12-year-old son cannot receive benefits for life
bilingualNotes.translation: 40岁的寡妇带着12岁的儿子不能领一辈子钱，儿子成年后，自己60岁之前不能领（blackout Period)
bilingualNotes.note: 儿子成年后到寡妇满60岁前为黑窗期，此期间不能领取
